notes.title: Welcoming 2025!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I'm the developer of YAN YUE DAO KILL. Thank you all for your incredible support and attention!

Currently, the game content is relatively simple and mainly serves as a way to test Steam's functionality and approval process. I didn’t expect so many players to join and enjoy the game, which has been truly heartwarming.

Regarding future updates, we are planning to release a major update in the second quarter of 2025. The game will undergo significant changes with brand-new gameplay and content. Updates will be rolled out in stages—once a portion of the content is completed, it will be released gradually, allowing players to experience the new features sooner. We will continue to keep the base game free to ensure the best experience for our players.

So the current version will no longer be updated. We kindly ask for your understanding!

Once again, thank you for your support and enthusiasm! I look forward to growing YAN YUE DAO KILL together with all of you!
